tei:div.tei:p: gnas nyi ma lta bu'i pho brang du*/ /chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'ja' tshon lta bu'i dkyil 'khor na/ /longs sku rigs lnga yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'og min chos kyi pho brang na/ /sprul sku sems dpa' bcu drug la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo na/ /rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod na/ /gu ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub snying po'i shing drung na/ /mkhas mchog shrī sidha la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bha sing chen po'i dur khrod na/ /paṇa chen bi ma mi tra la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bsam yas mchims phu'i dge gong na/ /nyang chen ting 'dzin bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo ru gzong phug pho brang na/ / sba sa ston blo gros dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ / bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /brag dkar rta so'i pho brang na/ /'brom ston rin chen 'bar ba la gsol ba 'debs/

/tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang na/ /ldang ma lhun gyis rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'od le zam kha'i pho brang na/ /lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo ru brag dmar pho brang na/ /gu ru shong pa ras pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo phug gsal ba'i dge sdings na/ /bla ma zab ston chos 'bar la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nyang smad chu sgo'i dgon pa na/ /dam pa dgyer ston yas sras la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nyang smad cho sgo'i sman sgang na/ /gnyen ston shes rab rtse mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yon tan sgang gi dben rtsa na/ /drin chen sprul sku mched gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ / bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dmigs bzhi 'od gsal ri khrod na/ /'khrul zhig nam mkha' rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sham po gangs kyis ra ba na/ /rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ / bar do 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /skyom bu dpal gyi dge sdings na/

/rgyal sras dri med 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /thar pa gling gi gnas mchog tu/ /mkhas grub bde legs rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sman rtsa gsang sngags pho brang na/ /mkhas grub bya btang chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bde chen rtse mo'i gnas mchog tu/ /byang sems gu ṇa shri la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ / bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sman rtse grub pa'i bsti gnas su/ /sprul sku bsam 'grub rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gar bzhugs chos kyi pho brang na/ /chos rje nam mkha' gzhon nu la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub gling gi gnas mchog tu/ /chos rje mkha' klong yangs pa la gsol ba 'debs/ / tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sman rtse rgyal ba'i pho brang du/ /mkhas btsun blo gros rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir lta dgongs ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༄༅/ /gsang skor bla ma brgyud rim gyi gsol 'debs so/

/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mi 'gyur lhun grub kun bzang rdo rje sems/ /dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ /shrī singha paṇa chen bi ma lar/ /gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'grub bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ting 'dzin bzang po blo gros dbang phyug dang*/ /rin chen 'bar ba lhun gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ /seng ge dbang phyug shong pa ras pa la/ / gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro skyong dang*/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pa gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'grub bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zab ston chos 'bar dam pa dgyer zhig dang*/ /shes rab rtse mo sprul sku mched gnyis dang*/ /nam mkha' rdo rje ku ma rā dza la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sna tshogs rang grol bde legs rgya mtsho dang*/ /ma ti maṃ ga byang sems chen po dang*/ /sprul sku bsam rgyal nam mkha' gzhon nu la/ / gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal sras dam pa mkha' klong yangs pa dang*/ /mkhas btsun chen po ma ti dh+wa dza dang*/ /rang grol lhug pa puṇ+yai rat+na la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/

/chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /gdod ma'i rgyal ba brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bar/ /dngos grub kun 'byung bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgrib bdag pa dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku gsum rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dang*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus tshogs dang bcas/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo rdo rje phag mo nas/ /rigs gsum rigs bzhi rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro dang*/ /rdo rje ging chen shugs 'gro thams cad la/ / gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgribs dag pa dang/ /bar dor 'od gsal 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i dbang phyug nas/ /'jig rten las byed mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rgyal ba rig 'dzin grub chen dpag med nas/ /phyi nang dam chos gzhung bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum snga phyi'i chos mdzad thams cad la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/

/chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'dir nad gdon sdig sgrib dag pa dang*/ / bar dor 'od gsal 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༄༅/ /gsol 'debs dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs so/ / gdod nas lhun grub gnas mchog tu/ /kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /stong gsal ka dag chos nyid la/ /zad sar skyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'og min chos dbyings gnas mchog tu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhun grub dag pa'i 'od gsal nyid/ /rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /ri rab ri ye rtse mo ru/ /dga' rab rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /ma 'gags rang shar rol ba nyid/ /thugs rjer 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog tu/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen gsol ba 'debs/ /rang gsal gzhi yi bsam gtan nyid/ / dgongs pa rang gnas byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /shrī singha ha gsol ba 'debs/ /ma spangs dbyings su rnam dag pa'i/ / chos dbyings rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bha sing chen po'i gnas mchog tu/ /bi ma mi tra la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma btsal lhun gyis rang grub pa'i/ / chos sku mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs/ /mchims phu dge gong gnas mchog tu/ /nyang ban chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /rang byung ye shes sgom pa nyid/ /bar mtshams med par byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo ru gzong phug gnas mchog tu/ /blo gros dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngo bo stong gsal rang rig nyid/ /mtha' dbus med par byin gyis rlobs/ /brag dkar rta so'i gnas mchog tu/ /rin chen 'bar bar gsol ba 'debs/ /rang bzhin lhun grub snang ba nyid/ /tshad la phebs par byin gyis rlobs/ /klungs shod zhwa yi gnas mchog tu/ /ldang ma lhun rgyal gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje rang shar rig pa nyid/ /rang grol chos skur byin gyis rlobs/ /'od le zam kha'i gnas mchog tu/

/seng ge dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdos bcas sgyu lus phung po 'di/ /'od lus dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yo ru brag dmar gnas mchog tu/ /shong pa ras par gsol ba 'debs/ /thams cad zad pa chos nyid dang*/ /rlung sems stong par byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yu phug gsal ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /zab ston chos 'bar gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor 'das rang snang stong pa'i ngang*/ /'khrul snang zad par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyang smad chu sgo'i gnas mchog na/ /dgyer ston zhig por gsol ba 'debs/ /sgo gsum bya bral chos nyid ngang*/ /bdag 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ / nyang smad sman sgang gnas mchog tu/ /shes rab rtse mor gsol ba 'debs/ / yul snang bden med gzhi bral ngang*/ gzung rtog grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yon tan sgang gi gnas mchog tu/ /sprul sku mched gnyis gsol ba 'debs/ /rig pa stong gsal zang thal ngang*/ /'dzin rtog grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /g.yu ru rgya smad gnas mchog tu/ /nam mkha' rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rang gdangs rig pa rgya yan dang*/ /chos zad dgongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyogs med ri khro gnas mchog tu/ /ku ma rā dzar gsol ba 'debs/ /thams cad rig pa zang thal dang*/ /ka dag dgongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /o rgyan rdzong gi gnas mchog tu/ /sna tshogs rang grol gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhi bral lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang*/ /dgongs pa rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /thar gling dpal gyi gnas mchog tu/ /bde legs rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen brtse'i rtogs pa mngon gyur nas/ / gzhan don mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs/ /sman rtse dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /ma ti maṃ gar gsol ba 'debs/ /'jig rten bya ba blos btang nas/ / ri khrod gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /sman rtse grub pa'i bsti gnas su/ /gu ṇa shī la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis/ /'gro rnams smin par byin gyis rlobs/

/sman rtse gsang sngags pho brang du/ /sprul sku bsam rgyal gsol ba 'debs/ /ma nges sprul bas 'gro ba'i don/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang bzhugs dag pa'i gnas mchog tu/ / nam mkha' gzhon nu gsol ba 'debs/ /sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i don/ /mtha' bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub gling gi gnas mchog tu/ /mkha' klong yangs par gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su/ /myur du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /sman rtse rgyal ba'i pho brang du/ /ma ti dh+wa dzar gsol ba 'debs/ /rang rig stong gsal zung 'jug don/ /mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /ye grol blo 'das gnyug ma'i don/ /myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gdul bya dad mos gnas mchog tu/ /bla ma kun la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang srid gzhi nas grol ba'i ngang*/ /dgongs pa chos skur byin gyis rlobs/ /gar bzhugs chos kyi gnas mchog tu/ /tshos mdzad yongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang ba chos su bsgyur ba dang*/ /dag snang 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /byin rlabs 'du ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /mkha' 'gro dam can gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang*/ /dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang byung ye shes gnas mchog tu/ /'khor 'das yongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /thams cad ye grol mnyam pa nyid/ /spang blang med par byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa dbang bsgyur thob pa dang*/ /rtogs pa 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang ba lam du lhongs pa dang*/ /rang gnas dgongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /byams dang snying rje 'byongs pa dang*/ /gzhan don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /nges 'byung blo sna thung ba dang*/ /'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs pa dang*/ /dgos med skye bar byin gyis rlobs/

/dngos 'dzin 'khrul ba zhig pa dang*/ /gzung 'dzin grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /cir snang sgyu mar 'byongs pa dang*/ /bdag 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /ban ma bun mar byin gyis rlobs/ /shag ma shig mar byin gyis rlobs/ khral ma khrol mar byin gyis rlobs/ /sang ma seng mar byin gyis rlobs/ /phyag ma phyol mar byin gyis rlobs/ /'ar ma 'ur mar byin gyis rlobs/ /chal ma chil mar byin gyis rlobs/ /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlabs/ /gsol 'debs dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba/ /theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor ba klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so/ ///dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)dgongs brgyud/ -PAGE 330--PAGE 339--PAGE 329-
